# DataverseConnection

- Namespace: `PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`
- Kind: Class

## Summary

Configuration for a Dataverse connection (Application User / Service Principal).
Multiple connections can be configured to distribute load across Application Users.

## Members

`DataverseConnection()`

Initializes a new instance of the `PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.DataverseConnection` class.

`DataverseConnection(string name)`

Initializes a new instance of the `PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.DataverseConnection` class.

- Param `name`: The unique name for this connection.

`string ToString()`
